caseNameFull: Kobilkin v. Pillsbury, Deputy Commissioner of U. S. Employees' Compensation Commission
attorneys: Mr. George Olshausen for petitioner. Solicitor General Jackson for Warren H. Pillsbury; and Messrs. Herman Phleger and Maurice E. Harrison for Matsou Navigation Co:, respondents.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis, and petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, granted.
